text: hour
1 Yeast cells produce an enzyme called invertase. Invertase catalyses the breakdown of sucrose
into reducing sugars. Sucrose is not a reducing sugar.
A student investigated the effect of two different concentrations of invertase extract on a sucrose
solution.
The student used this method:
Step 1 Label three test-tubes A, B and W.
Step 2 Use a syringe to put 2 cm of sucrose solution into all three test-tubes.
Step 3 Use a clean syringe to put 2 cm of 100% invertase extract into test-tube A.
Step 4 Use a clean syringe to put 2 cm of 10% invertase extract into test-tube B.
Step 5 Use a clean syringe to put 2 cm of distilled water into test-tube W.
Step 6 Put all three test-tubes in a warm water-bath at 40 °C for 15 minutes.
Step 7 Measure the temperature of the liquid in the test-tubes.
